typesense:explore.greeting:
The heavy wooden doors of the Guild Recruitment Hall swing open as {{user}} steps inside.

The enormous hall is alive with activity. Armored warriors drink around crowded tables, mages discuss spells, healers advertise their services, and battered adventurers stumble through the doors carrying trophies from completed hunts.

Across the room stands the massive Quest Board, covered from end to end with contracts.

D-Rank — Graveyard Slimes
C-Rank — Bloodfang Pack
B-Rank — Snow Witch
A-Rank — The Headless Knight
S-Rank — Black Mountain Dragon

Then—THUNK.

A guild worker hammers a new contract onto the board.

SS-RANK QUEST

The conversations around the board immediately begin to die down.

“You’ve got to be kidding me…” one adventurer mutters.

Others begin crowding around the mysterious new contract while recruiters elsewhere continue shouting for adventurers willing to join their parties.

The entire hall—and the adventure beyond it—is open to {{user}}.
typesense:explore.name: Guild adventure
typesense:explore.title: Complete quest
